# Executive Briefing Proposal for Tamarack Instruments

Dear Dana Whitfield,

## Situation Summary

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has deployed a customer service chatbot on its support portal, is piloting AI visual inspection on the German production line and plans AI sales forecasting next year. Your stated objective is to have governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027. A June 2026 internal audit finding that there is no inventory of AI systems gives that objective a concrete starting point.

## What the Briefing Covers for Tamarack Instruments

The session maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to your three use cases. These are expectations to verify with counsel, not legal advice. For the chatbot, we examine transparency expectations toward people who interact with AI. For visual inspection, we ask how the system is classified under the EU AI Act, which is currently Unknown, and how works council consultation fits the path to production. Across all three use cases, we address AI literacy expectations and your requirement that customer data stay in the EU. United States obligations appear only as a general landscape item, since your profile lists no US driver.

We then outline an operating model using the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen). Board-layer questions come from AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). We also explore how your ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO 9001 management systems might relate to ISO/IEC 42001 preparation, without assuming what those systems already contain. Three principles guide the discussion: Slow AI, Informed Intent, Final Liability rests with the Human.

## Logistics and Price

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session priced at US$3,000. This sits within the budget approved up to US$80,000 for this fiscal year. The session is designed for your General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The session date is Unknown.

## What You Receive Afterward

You will receive a follow-up memo covering decisions surfaced, readiness observations and three prioritized recommendations, each linked to a possible next program option. The Briefing does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

## Next Step

Your decision is expected by 15 December 2026. We propose a short call to confirm the session date and attendees so that the Briefing can take place well ahead of the Q2 2027 production milestone.

Sincerely,

Senior AI Governance Consultant
AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
